en: Emilio Aguinaldo was the first president of the First Philippine Republic, not Jose Rizal.
Emilio Aguinaldo designed the Philippine flag, and Marcela Agoncillo sewed its first official version.
Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista authored and read the 1898 Philippine Declaration of Independence in Spanish.
The Senate and the House of Representatives together form the Legislative branch of the Philippine government.
Filipino citizens must be at least eighteen years old to register and vote in national elections.
The Sampaguita is the official national flower of the Philippines, not the Waling-waling orchid.
The Igorot indigenous peoples primarily inhabit the mountainous Cordillera region of northern Luzon.
The Cebu Sinulog festival honors the Santo Niño, the child Jesus, rather than Philippine independence.
Filipino scientist Gregorio Zara invented the two-way television telephone, not the standard television set.
Filipino is the national language, while both Filipino and English serve as official languages of the Philippines.
Andres Bonifacio founded the Katipunan, a secret revolutionary society that fought against Spanish colonial rule.
Arnis is the official national martial art and sport of the Philippines, not basketball.
